message:
The other day, we found ourselves in a bit of a frenzy as a storm was rolling in, and our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. 💬 Everyone was throwing in their two cents about what to pack in our go-bags, from snacks and games for the kids to extra batteries for the flashlights. It reminded us how important it is to have a plan, but also how comforting it is to have each other to lean on during moments of uncertainty. 

In the end, we decided to make our emergency prep a family affair, turning it into a fun little project rather than a chore. Isn’t it funny how a little communication can turn a stressful situation into something we tackle together? What’s your go-to for keeping the family connected in a pinch?
